thread:
jordan: Quick heads-up — planning to deploy routing-service v2.1.0 to prod at 16:30 PT today (~30m). This is a capacity + routing rules change, low-risk but touching traffic split. Need someone to own post-deploy verification and rollback readiness.

maya: I can take verification for the first 30m after deploy. Will run the usual checks and watch traces.

alex: tagging @maya - noted. I’ll be on standby for rollback, I have the rollback plan ready (`k8s rollback` snippet in the runbook).

leila: Obs changes: I pushed one dashboard panel tweak to staging: split per-route p50/p95 separate, and reduced trace sample to 1% for the noisy route. Planning to sync that to prod during the deploy window. Any objections?

sam: Sounds fine. Can you also add a temporary alert suppression for noisy routing spikes so we don't get paged during traffic rebalancing?

leila: Good call — will set a short suppression for 45m starting at deploy + 5m. Also bump alert threshold for `route_error_rate` from 0.5% -> 1.5% for the window. I'll paste the small change here:

```yaml
# temporary alert override
alert: route_error_rate
expr: (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"routing-service\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"routing-service\"}[5m]))) * 100
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  summary: "Temporary: elevated error rate threshold for routing deploy window"
  description: "Raised threshold to 1.5% to avoid noisy alerts during rollout"
```

jordan: thanks. Maya — checklist for verification please? Keep it lightweight, we want fast signal.

maya: Plan: 1) smoke healthy pods via `/healthz` curl across a few nodes; 2) run traffic split validation script (internal/tooling/route-checker); 3) spot-check traces for the rebalanced route in tempo (filter by trace tag `route=v2`); 4) confirm no new 5xx rate > 0.5% at p95. If anything odd, ping here + call rollback.

alex: For rollback: run `kubectl rollout undo deployment/routing-service -n prod --to-revision=78` (I stored the revision). If rollout fails, manual scale-up of previous RS is the fallback. I’ll be on pager phone 16:20-17:30.

devops: Deploy bot scheduled the window. CI status: passing, canary tests green on staging. Noting that the canary had ~2% increased tail-latency under synthetic spike — should watch p99.

maya: will watch p50/p95/p99 + trace spans for latency regressions. If p99 jumps >200ms sustained for 3min, we consider rollback.

sre-bot: Reminder: runbook link -> https://internal/runbooks/routing-deploy. Quick commands: `curl -sS https://prod-routing/healthz` and `internal/route-checker --check-splits`.

leila: Also adding one short-lived dashboard panel: `routing.v2: 5xx rate by route` and a trace quicklink. Will push it at T+2m post-deploy so we have fresh metrics.

sam: I set a temporary slack alert channel mute for the critical-alerts channel for 50m to avoid noise. Will unmute after. :white_check_mark:

jordan: Great — owners: @maya verification, @alex rollback, @leila observability changes, @sam alert-mute. Deploy at 16:30 PT. If anyone needs to shift timing reply ASAP. Otherwise I’ll kick at 16:28.

maya: ACK. Will post verification summary here at +10m and +30m.

alex: ACK. Standby.

leila: ACK — will paste the alert override ID after I apply it.

devops: Starting deploy in ~5m, CI final smoke running.

jordan: Kicking in 2 min. Good luck everyone :rocket:
